public.instruction: Observe a lazy command sequence using actions list, len, truthy or first, returning one result per action. commands contains unique script strings with distinct integer priorities. The first input command stays first; once realized, remaining commands are sorted by ascending priority. Empty sequences have list [], length 0 and false truthiness; first on empty raises IndexError. Repeated observations are stable. All side effects are None, and no command is executed. Duplicate scripts, equal priorities and side effects are outside scope.
